ruleDefinitions.name: UAC Bypass Using Event Viewer RecentViews
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the pattern of UAC Bypass using Event Viewer RecentViews

sequences.query: ((process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\Event\\ Viewer\\\\RecentViews.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\EventV\\~1\\\\RecentViews.*")) AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\>.*"))
